summary: Premium/Admin flow end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend 14/14 pass (test_premium_admin.py): non-premium AI gated by 402, admin listing + toggle, non-admin gets 403, real Stripe checkout URL, pending payment_status, cleanup. Frontend flows PASS: gen-text-btn/gen-image-btn open premium-dialog with ZERO /api/ai calls, compose-free-btn still works for non-premium, nav-upgrade opens dialog, premium-upgrade-btn calls /api/payments/checkout (200), and — most importantly — admin can grant premium and the newly-premium mago successfully generates real content via /api/ai/generate-content (name='Dardo di Scintille', 212-char on-topic description matching prompt 'danni da fuoco', full spell attributes). Final state left CLEAN: mago non-premium, is_premium=false, premium_manual=false. FOUND 1 REAL BUG: /api/auth/login response is missing is_admin/is_premium flags, so RIGHT AFTER LOGIN the frontend user context lacks these — admin sees nav-upgrade instead of nav-premium-badge and does NOT see nav-admin (PANNELLO ADMIN) in the user dropdown. A page reload fixes it (because checkAuth() then calls /api/auth/me which returns the flags). Reproduced twice.

Reviewed brief says NOT to spend image credits. Only 402 gate verified end-to-end (backend + frontend both confirm 402 for non-premium AND that clicking gen-image-btn does NOT fire /api/ai/*). Endpoint auth/premium wiring is identical to generate-content, which was verified real.

HTTP 200; checkout_url starts with 'https://checkout.stripe.com/'; session_id starts with 'cs_'. GET /api/payments/status/{sid} returns payment_status='unpaid' as expected pre-payment. Hosted-checkout page not driven (external domain; sandbox key).

critical.issue: Response user object does NOT include is_admin/is_premium/premium_manual/premium_until fields (returned only by /api/auth/me). Frontend Landing.jsx calls loginWithToken(res.data.token, res.data.user) storing this incomplete user; the Navbar hides nav-admin (PANNELLO ADMIN) and shows nav-upgrade (Premium button) even for admin users until the page is reloaded (which triggers checkAuth -> /api/auth/me). Reproduced twice.

ui_bugs.issue: After successful login, nav-admin dropdown item is missing for admin users, and nav-premium-badge does not appear for premium users, because the user object populated by loginWithToken(...) came from /api/auth/login which omits those flags. A full page reload works around it. Fix: either (a) call checkAuth() right after loginWithToken() so /api/auth/me refreshes flags, or (b) have /api/auth/login return the same shape as /api/auth/me (include is_admin, is_premium, premium_manual, premium_until).

action_items: FIX auth-login shape mismatch: update /api/auth/login (and /api/auth/register) to include is_admin, is_premium, premium_manual, premium_until in the user payload (mirroring /api/auth/me), OR update Landing.jsx to call checkAuth() after loginWithToken() so the missing flags are pulled in immediately. This is the only blocker preventing an admin from seeing PANNELLO ADMIN without a manual page refresh.

PremiumDialog.jsx does window.location.href = res.data.checkout_url which is fine but any error after redirect is lost. Consider a small try/catch on the checkout_url validation before redirecting.

rca of the issue: AuthContext.loginWithToken(token, userData) stores whatever the caller passed. Landing.jsx passes res.data.user from POST /api/auth/login. That endpoint (server.py L303-311) builds a hand-crafted dict of {user_id,email,name,picture,auth_provider} — it does NOT include is_admin, is_premium, premium_manual, premium_until. So immediately after login the React user context has undefined for those flags -> Navbar hides nav-admin, hides nav-premium-badge, shows nav-upgrade. A page reload runs the AuthProvider useEffect -> checkAuth() -> GET /api/auth/me which DOES include is_premium+is_admin via compute_premium(user), and the UI corrects itself. Fix: mirror the /api/auth/me shape in login/register responses (preferred) OR call checkAuth() inside loginWithToken().
